steps.evidence: README.md:57-63 (env vars from .env.example; `vercel link` + `vercel env pull`)
README.md:67 (`pnpm db:migrate` = tsx lib/db/migrate.ts, Drizzle migrator)

notes: Env must hold real values before start: AUTH_SECRET (random secret), POSTGRES_URL, AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY (non-Vercel; Vercel uses OIDC); BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN (Vercel Blob, file uploads) and REDIS_URL (resumable streams/rate limit, code skips it when unset) are optional. .env.example values are '****' placeholders. README's main path is Vercel CLI (`vercel link`, `vercel env pull`) which writes .env.local; README also says 'a .env file is all that is necessary', but lib/db/migrate.ts and drizzle.config.ts load only .env.local, so with a plain .env `pnpm db:migrate` prints 'POSTGRES_URL not defined, skipping migrations' and exits 0. pnpm (packageManager pnpm@10.32.1, pnpm-lock.yaml; CI pnpm install --frozen-lockfile). No engines/.nvmrc; Node 20 is the CI floor (lint.yml matrix [20]; playwright.yml uses lts/*); Next 16.2. `pnpm build` also runs migrations. Postgres is expected to be a hosted (Neon) database; no compose file.
